continual_6task_stream.description: Replay-free continual adaptation of a frozen linear classifier over six-task streams (the paper's Continual GLUE stream length, Table 1). Scored on six hidden streams, 1000 held-out examples per task.
continual_6task_stream.notes: Scaled setting: a frozen 20x96 linear map instead of RoBERTa-base on GLUE, synthetic related tasks instead of GLUE tasks. The paper's Table 1 averages are kept as context for the accuracy direction only; they are not on this benchmark's scale. Paper resource numbers are not on this scale either and are kept under _paper_reported. Runs that exceed the continual-learning budget (shared state > one rank-12 adapter = 1392 parameters, or > 139 parameters per task) or whose final average accuracy is below 40% are scored as failed with bounded worst values (accuracy 0, forgetting 100, parameter fraction 1). Failure in either required experiment fails the whole attempt. Paper-reported values are preserved only under _paper_reported; the reference on this scaled task is evaluator-owned.

final_average_accuracy.description: Mean over hidden streams of the final accuracy (%) averaged over all tasks of the stream, from the state deployed after the last task.

average_forgetting.description: Mean over streams of the average drop (percentage points) from each earlier task's best accuracy across the per-task snapshots to its final accuracy; recomputed by the evaluator from the snapshots.

parameter_fraction_vs_lora_stream.description: Parameters in the final deployed state (counted from its arrays) divided by the evaluator-fixed cost of storing one rank-12 adapter per task (T x 12 x (20 + 96)).

compression_ratio_vs_lora_stream.description: Inverse of parameter_fraction_vs_lora_stream; reported for comparison with the paper's compression claims, not scored separately.

stored_parameters.description: Raw count of parameters in the final deployed state (mean over streams); reported only.

worst_task_accuracy.description: Mean over streams of the lowest final per-task accuracy (%); reported only, as a collapse diagnostic.

_paper_reported.source: Table 1, Continual GLUE with RoBERTa-base, mean of 3 seeds

continual_6task_stream._results_source: Scaled reproduced reference measurements, independently verified from raw snapshots; paper measurements are exclusively in _paper_reported.

continual_10task_stream.description: Replay-free continual adaptation over ten-task streams (the paper's image-classification stream length, Table 2), where storage savings should grow with stream length and accumulated merges stress retention. Scored on four hidden streams, 1000 held-out examples per task.
continual_10task_stream.notes: Scaled setting: a frozen 20x96 linear map instead of a pretrained ViT-B/16 on class-incremental vision datasets. The paper's CIFAR-100 Share accuracy is kept as context for the direction only; it is not on this benchmark's scale. Same budget and task-success gate as the six-task experiment (budget 1392 shared + 139 per task; floor 40%). Failure in either required experiment fails the whole attempt. Paper-reported values are preserved only under _paper_reported; the reference on this scaled task is evaluator-owned.
